events.summary: 塔拉辛与阿拉里克一同走到摄政盖赫里斯面前，盖赫里斯说这一幕早该发生。
events.quote: He blinked at Talasyn’s greeting, but quickly recovered from his surprise as she and Alaric stopped in unison a short distance away from him.

events.summary: 盖赫里斯讥问塔拉辛是否还把“女皇”算作自己的头衔。
events.quote: “Do you still count Empress among those titles, I wonder?” Gaheris asked, and the beginnings of a satisfied smile bloomed on his withered lips when she went tense but said nothing.

events.summary: 盖赫里斯伸手放出墨色锁链，却被隐形之物抽出血痕而缩手。
events.quote: But Gaheris abruptly snatched back his hand with an intake of breath. Blood dripped down his nails, as though something invisible had lashed at him like a whip.

events.summary: 阿拉里克承认自己故意没警告父亲，好让塔拉辛有反抗的机会。
events.quote: Alaric had wanted to give Talasyn a fighting chance if she were ever to go up against his father.

events.summary: 塔拉辛散掉魔法，独自走到盖赫里斯的爪脚椅前逼视他。
events.quote: And, as Alaric watched, his wife marched right up to the claw-foot chair, stopping only once she was within arm’s reach of his father, staring Gaheris down with an air of quiet menace.

events.summary: 塔拉辛怒斥盖赫里斯在毁掉一个他自己也活不久的世界。
events.quote: “You’re destroying a world you’re not even going to live in much longer,” she snarled at him.

events.summary: 盖赫里斯释放暗门，把塔拉辛抬离地面折磨。
events.quote: Then the Shadowgate erupted into being, a sudden, jagged cloud of midnight, surrounding her and lifting her off the floor.

events.summary: 塔拉辛在痛苦中听见先祖女声说“他不过是个男人”，随后睁眼放出光。
events.quote: an unbroken line of clan matriarchs and Dominion queens, speaking into the chasms of aetherspace, speaking to her and through her. But, daughter—he is just a man.

relations.relation: 敌对／言语交锋，她要求他以正式头衔称呼自己
relations.quote: “I have several titles,” she replied stiffly, “and I’d appreciate it if you offered me the courtesy of using at least one of them, Regent Gaheris.”

relations.relation: 父子；父亲以轻蔑的口吻夸他“把人及时带来”
relations.quote: His icy gaze darted to Alaric over her shoulder. “You did well, bringing her to me so promptly.

relations.relation: 夫妻；她早前在礁岛上肯定过他的价值
relations.quote: It was such a different sentiment from what Talasyn had expressed on the skerry—You have always been worthy. To me, you are worth everything—that Alaric very nearly couldn’t suppress a shudder.

relations.b: 先祖女声（女族长与自治领女王一脉）
relations.relation: 血脉召唤，众声唤她“女儿”
relations.quote: that was one voice and yet hundreds upon hundreds of voices, a multitude of images racing together like comets in the night, their splinters spiraling backward into rivers of time

numbers.context: 盖赫里斯把塔拉辛与阿拉里克比作两只被困的啮齿动物
numbers.quote: like a predator lazily switching its attention back and forth between two trapped rodents

numbers.context: 盖赫里斯原以为儿子会反抗
numbers.quote: I was half expecting that you’d put up a fight

numbers.context: 先祖记忆中出现的七个月亮
numbers.quote: young sun, seven moons, an unbroken line of clan matriarchs and Dominion queens

numbers.context: 附身于塔拉辛的无数声音
numbers.quote: that was one voice and yet hundreds upon hundreds of voices, a multitude of images racing together like comets in the night
